question: Team TS3007's energy source changed between meetings. What did they first settle on, what did they end with, and who proposed the change?

steps.answer: They first settled on battery plus kinetic (shake-to-charge) power, proposed by C (industrial designer) in meeting c, but in meeting d A (project manager) proposed dropping kinetic for cost/innovation reasons, finalizing a battery-only design.
